facts.fact: Wacker 发邮件命令 KRAY 立刻过来，KRAY 随即前往，并带上刚完成的 Project GOOWIKI 报告副本。
facts.anchor: So KRAY went there then. He took along copies of his just-completed report on Project GOOWIKI.

facts.fact: Wacker 的行政助理 Judy 让 KRAY 在沙发上等候并向 Wacker 通报，KRAY 等了二十五分钟。
facts.anchor: Judy, Wacker’s administrative assistant, asked KRAY to sit on the sofa while she let Wacker know he was there. KRAY waited twenty-five minutes.

facts.fact: Wacker 列出对 KRAY 的指控：不服从、不可接受的个人行为、未报告与外国人的会面，还可能有其他问题。
facts.anchor: “Insubordination,” said Wacker. “Unacceptable personal conduct. Failure to report a meeting with a foreigner. Maybe other things, too.

facts.fact: Wacker 说 BUTTONFLY 现在是承包商，已经没有网络，朋友都已退休或去世。
facts.anchor: But he’s a contractor now, he doesn’t even have a network anymore. All his friends have retired or died.

facts.fact: Wacker 称 KRAY 在印度 Varanasi 与印度内务部门的公开代表会面喝茶，监视组拍下了两人喝茶的照片。
facts.anchor: “In India,” said Wacker, consulting a sheet of paper on the table in front of him. “Some place called ‘Varanasi.’ You met with a declared representative of the Indian internal service there. Apparently he also moonlights as private security for some Indian rich guy who owns hotels. A surveillance team following him took pictures of you two having tea together.

facts.fact: Wacker 说自己有个与 KANDINSKY 同龄的女儿，称 KANDINSKY 很有吸引力，并指责作为资深官员的 KRAY 不该让这段关系发生。
facts.anchor: “I have a daughter her age,” said Wacker. “KANDINSKY’s a very attractive young woman. Very attractive. But you never should have let that happen. You’re the senior officer.”

facts.fact: FILBERT 宣布 KRAY 的后续任命暂停，总部给他一个隔间，若有人占用就去图书馆。
facts.anchor: “Your onward assignment is on hold,” he said. “We have a cubicle in Headquarters for you to sit in. If somebody’s in it, you can sit in the Library.”

facts.fact: FILBERT 通知 KRAY 周一上午九点三十分与反间谍组（Counterespionage Group）有约谈。
facts.anchor: “You have an appointment with the Counterespionage Group on Monday morning at zero nine thirty hours,” said FILBERT.
